call.description: Run another workflow from this one and carry on with what it sends back. Pass values into the inputs it declares, and read its outputs in later steps. The workflow you call runs as part of this run, with its own entry in the run history.
call.name: call

parameters.description: The workflow to run. It has to be a published workflow in this workspace that doesn't start from a trigger.
parameters.name: workflow_id

parameters.description: The chosen workflow's name, kept so this step still reads clearly if the workflow is later renamed.
parameters.name: workflow_name

parameters.description: The values to pass in, one per input the chosen workflow declares. Each is checked against the type that workflow declared for it.
parameters.name: inputs

returns.description: The outputs the workflow declares, one field each, with the types it declares for them.

description: Run one of your other workflows and use what it returns, or start a workflow when another one fails.

skipflow_workflows_run_failed_trigger.description: Runs when another workflow in this workspace fails, and receives which workflow and step failed, the error, and a link to the run.

parameters.description: The workflow to watch. Leave blank to run for every workflow in this workspace except this one.
parameters.name: workflow_id

parameters.description: The chosen workflow's name, kept so this step still reads clearly if the workflow is later renamed.
parameters.name: workflow_name
